ruling.recommended_action: Reverse the $6.61 cancellation fee and issue the rider a Ryde voucher of $6.61 (NS-7); no driver account flag warranted (NS-2 flag condition not met — the driver never tapped "I'm Here").
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is two ordinary arrival/ETA messages (F7, F8), the driver statement is neutral (F10), the complaint contains no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. safety_concern = none.

Merits: this is a rider-side cancellation, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-4 (on-demand booking). NS-4: cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable. Timeline shows acceptance at 18:23:00 and rider cancellation at 18:25:30 (F2) — 2 min 30 s ≤ 3:00, so under NS-4 no cancellation fee is chargeable. The $6.61 charged (F5) is therefore not owed and must be refunded in full.

The driver's no-show claim does not change this: NS-1 requires (i) an "I'm Here" tap or platform auto-arrival, (ii) the driver within 200 m of the pickup at that moment, and (iii) >3 min continuous waiting. The record shows the driver never tapped and the platform recorded no arrival (F4), and the closest approach was 1816 m (F1, F3), so NS-1 fails outright and cannot support a fee. Because the driver never pressed "I'm Here", the NS-2 account-flag trigger (tap while GPS shows him outside 200 m) is not met, so no flag. Traffic facts (F11, F12) and weather (F13) are irrelevant to a within-3-minute rider cancellation; NS-8's ETA-based relief is informative only and not needed.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement 'I was on my way when the rider cancelled' is a claim, and it is contradicted by system records: GPS puts him 1816 m away and no arrival was ever recorded [F1][F3][F4]. In any event it does not make the cancellation fee chargeable — NS-4 waives it within 3 minutes of matching [F2].
